metadata.description: 可复用的 Claude Code / Agent skills 集合,按 workflow / repo 两类组织。

plugins.name: layered-ci-autofix
plugins.description: 运行时闭环:commit/push → 监督 PR CI → 读结构化信号按 layer 自动修 → 修完再等 CI。repo-kit 的 run-time 消费者,门复用 auto-review-merge。

plugins.name: multica-issue
plugins.description: 向 Multica dev team 提 issue 并直接派发触发 pipeline:反查 project、分类 bug/功能/架构、带 layer red_lines+test、三步 dispatch + run 验证。

plugins.name: to-tickets
plugins.description: Turn an accepted spec and plan into vertical product slices plus a dependency graph of layer-scoped implementation tasks. Use when Planner Lead creates or refines Spec Kit `tasks.md` or Multica child issues for work that spans one or more repository layers.
